TME's mission is to create endless possibilities with music and technology. Powered by its content-and-platform dual-engine strategy, TME's expansive offerings extend the value of IP beyond online streaming into offline concerts, artist merchandise, and other IP-centric experiences.

analysis_md:
# TME — Tencent Music Entertainment Group

Engine 5.4.0 pass-1 run, 2026-10-17. IFRS 20-F filer (CNY, converted to USD by the engine at period-end ECB rates). All per-share figures below are **per ADS** (1 ADS = 2 Class A ordinary shares; see ADS_RATIO_APPLIED). All figures are copied from dcf_numbers.json, financials_history.csv, fundamentals.json or the cited company releases — none are recomputed.

## What it is
China's leading online music and audio platform: QQ Music, Kugou Music and Kuwo Music (streaming/subscriptions), WeSing (karaoke/social entertainment), and — since the acquisition closed on May 18, 2026 — Ximalaya in long-form audio. Tencent Holdings is the controlling shareholder. Q2 2026: total revenue RMB8.93B (+5.8% YoY), of which music-related services RMB7.61B (+11.0%), membership services RMB4.79B (+8.1%), social entertainment RMB1.33B (−16.4%); gross margin 44.2%; IFRS net profit attributable RMB2.47B. Price $8.63/ADS (nasdaq_quote_api). The engine's market_cap_est ($27.02B) multiplies the ADS price by the ordinary-share count and so double-counts the ADS ratio; on the diluted count in ADS terms (3,130,861,720 ordinary shares = ~1.565B ADS) the cap is roughly half the engine figure — under the $40B scope limit either way.

## Owner's earnings
FY2024 (latest fiscal year in EDGAR companyfacts, USD as converted in financials_history.csv): operating cash flow $1,407,675,000; capex $43,703,000; SBC $81,652,000 (always a real cost).
- **Conservative owner's earnings FY2024: $1,282,320,000 = $0.82/ADS** (latest FY OE/share, dcf_numbers.json).
- Maintenance version (NI + D&A − min(capex, D&A) − ΔNWC): $1,015,472,250 for FY2024 — same ballpark; the gap is a working-capital build in a year when OCF itself jumped.
- OE positive 5 of the last 5 fiscal years. OE/share (per ADS) by year: FY2022 $0.60, FY2023 $0.58, FY2024 $0.82.
- **Base used = the engine's normalized base: median of the last 3 FY OE/share = $0.6033/ADS** (base_source: median_of_last_3_fy_oe_per_share). Per the worker spec for IFRS filers, ttm.py cannot build a TTM base (it reads us-gaap only; it exited non-zero for TME), so the median base stands and the staleness is handled through confidence and the method range below.
- Balance sheet (from the filings/releases, because the engine's debt tags are blank for FY2024 — see DEBT_TAGS_BLANK): the company is deeply net cash. Cash, cash equivalents, term deposits and short-term investments were RMB44.22B (US$6.52B) at June 30, 2026 and RMB38.04B at December 31, 2025. The engine's cash line ($1,803,468,000 at FY2024) captures only cash & equivalents, not term deposits/short-term investments, so it understates the pile. Borrowings of ~$0.79B (converted) were tagged in FY2020–FY2023 and no borrowings tag reports for FY2024; lease liabilities are $44,525,000. Capital return is real: a US$0.24/ADS dividend for FY2025 was paid in April 2026, and the company repurchased 43.5M ADSs for ~US$400M in Q2 2026 alone.

## Moat: 6/10 — moderate-strong, not wide
Justification: China's dominant online music platform with Tencent as controlling shareholder and ecosystem distribution, major-label content relationships, a fast-growing SVIP subscription tier and, since May 2026, Ximalaya in long-form audio. Gross margin expanded from 30.1% (2021) to 42.3% (2024) and 44.2% in Q2 2026 as the mix shifted to subscriptions; roic_proxy (fundamentals.json, CNY as filed) rose from 6.8% (2021) to 8.6% (2022), 10.6% (2023) and 12.6% (2024) — above the cost of capital and rising, but not the sustained mid-teens-plus of a wide moat, and the proxy denominator excludes most of the cash/term-deposit/short-term-investment pile, so measured ROIC understates the franchise somewhat.
- FOR: dominant share of China online music (QQ Music, Kugou, Kuwo) plus WeSing; Tencent controlling shareholder — WeChat/QQ ecosystem distribution and promotion; major-label and proprietary content relationships, SVIP tier raising per-user monetization; Ximalaya acquisition (closed May 18, 2026) extends the moat into long-form audio; fortress balance sheet (RMB44.22B cash, term deposits and short-term investments at Jun 30, 2026; negligible borrowings).
- AGAINST: no exclusive catalog lock-in since the 2021 SAMR ruling — rivals license the same music; ByteDance (Soda Music) and NetEase Cloud Music competition for listening time; social entertainment services in structural decline (−16.4% YoY in Q2 2026) under regulatory pressure; measured ROIC only ~9–13% in recent years — solid, not wide-moat; China regulatory and geopolitical (ADR/VIE) overhang.
- A 6 gives CAP = 9.8 years: growth holds 2 years, then converges linearly to the 2.5% terminal rate over 9.8 years, 15-year projection.

## DCF — engine 5.4 final run (2026-10-17)
Growth recalibration (written reason): the engine's blended growth start is 2.79%, but its components are dominated by the social-entertainment collapse years — adjusted components: 5-yr revenue CAGR +3.62%, 3-yr revenue CAGR −5.16%, latest FY revenue YoY +1.97%, OE/share CAGR 2y +16.51%, share count −2.36%/yr. That blend sits below what the company is printing now: Q1 2026 revenue +7.3% YoY and Q2 2026 +5.8% (music-related services +12.2% / +11.0%), with buybacks running well above the historical 2.4%/yr pace. Scenario starts were therefore shifted up via offsets (−0.09 / −0.02 / +0.03 / +0.08 / +0.15 vs the blend) to −6.2 / +0.8 / **+5.8** / +10.8 / +17.8%: the base start matches current total-revenue prints, the bull start matches the music-services print, and the super-bull start sits just above the filed 2-yr OE/share CAGR (16.51%) rather than above anything the company has actually printed. Probabilities 10/25/30/25/10; OE multipliers 0.75/0.90/1.00/1.10/1.25. Price $8.63/ADS.

| Scenario | Prob | Growth start | OE mult | Story | IV@15 | IRR |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Super bear | 10% | −6.2% | 0.75 | Regulatory/ByteDance shock; social decline accelerates, music stalls | $2.52 | 5.76% |
| Bear | 25% | +0.8% | 0.90 | Music growth only offsets the social-entertainment bleed | $4.13 | 8.40% |
| Base | 30% | +5.8% | 1.00 | Current prints persist: subscriptions + IP/concerts carry, social shrinks | $5.73 | 10.92% |
| Bull | 25% | +10.8% | 1.10 | Music-services pace sustained; Ximalaya synergies land | $7.87 | 13.99% |
| Super bull | 10% | +17.8% | 1.25 | Per-share compounding at the filed 2-yr OE/share CAGR, buybacks on top | $12.19 | 19.22% |

- **Probability-weighted: IV@15% $6.19 (−28.3% vs price), IV@12% $8.29, IV@10% $10.64, weighted IRR 11.65%, base-case IRR 10.92%**
- **Tier by numbers: C.** Bear-case tier D (8.40%), bull-case tier C (13.99%) — TIER_BAND: size to the bear end. Diagnostics: OE yield 6.99%, terminal value 19.6% of IV@15%, scenario spread 4.84x, 21.5 months since FY end. Hurdle prices: clears 15% at $6.19, 20% at $4.31, 25% at $3.29.

## Flags — every fragility flag resolved
- **STALE_FY** (latest FY ended 21.5 months ago): real and unresolved by construction — the FY2025 Form 20-F was filed 2026-04-17 but its facts are not yet in EDGAR companyfacts (fundamentals.py flags the same gap), and ttm.py reads us-gaap only, so no filing-direct TTM base exists for this IFRS filer. Handled per spec: the normalized median base is used, quarterly 6-K prints (Q1/Q2 2026, cited above) were used for the growth sanity check and scenario calibration, and confidence is set to low.
- **BASE_DIVERGENCE** (latest FY OE/share $0.82/ADS vs 3-yr median $0.60/ADS): the median is the conservative one, not the distorted one. FY2022–23 OE was depressed by the social-entertainment revenue collapse and content-cost restructuring; FY2024 reflects the cleaned-up subscription mix (gross margin 42.3% vs 31.0% in FY2022) plus buybacks. The median base is retained as the headline (it is the v5 normalized base), and the latest-FY base is carried as the top of the method range below. Note the FY2025 20-F (not in companyfacts) shows net profit attributable of RMB11,056M vs RMB6,644M in FY2024 — but H1 2026 disclosures show the FY2025 figure included large non-recurring other gains (H1 net profit fell from RMB6,700M in H1 2025 to RMB4,562M in H1 2026 on lower other gains), so it is not a clean run-rate either.
- **NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE** (2022): benign. FY2022 net income was $556,463,050 vs operating cash flow of $1,084,370,950 (financials_history.csv, converted). The gap is non-cash addbacks (D&A $168,142,000 + SBC $96,391,750) plus a large working-capital release (ΔNWC −$768,494,350 in the maintenance-OE legs) as social-entertainment content prepayments and payables unwound while that segment shrank. The conservative OE used throughout is OCF-based, so the divergence does not contaminate the base.
- **BUYBACK_TAILWIND** (share count −2.36%/yr): already credited via the +2.36pp share-count adjustment in the growth blend; not double-counted. Note the actual pace has accelerated (~US$400M of ADS repurchases in Q2 2026 alone) — that upside is carried in the bull/super-bull starts, not the base.
- **FX_CONVERTED**: CNY converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app; rates recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion, e.g. 0.1370 for 2024-12-31). Flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average — a known, uniform approximation across all years.
- **ADS_RATIO_APPLIED**: 1 ADS = 2 Class A ordinary shares, from the FY2025 Form 20-F (filed 2026-04-17) EPS note — "One ADS represents two Class A ordinary shares of the Company" (also Note 1.1). judgment.json carries ads_ratio {ratio: 2, source, reason} under the bounded filing authority; the engine scaled per-share figures x2 onto the ADS basis. Without it the score would compare per-ordinary-share value against the per-ADS price and understate value by half.
- **DEBT_TAGS_BLANK** (no debt tag for the latest FY): net debt is unknown to the engine, not zero. Stated from the filings instead: borrowings of ~$0.79B (converted) were tagged FY2020–FY2023 and none report for FY2024, lease liabilities are $44,525,000, and cash + term deposits + short-term investments were RMB44.22B (US$6.52B) at June 30, 2026 — the company is deeply net cash under any reading, so no leverage adjustment is warranted.
- **WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD** (4.84x): real — the range runs from a regulatory/competition shock to filed-CAGR compounding. Confidence is low (compounded by STALE_FY), and the verdict is sized to the conservative end.
- **TIER_BAND** (bear D vs bull C): the weighted verdict (C, 11.65%) sits between the cases; any position should be sized to the bear end (8.40%).

## My thoughts / method range
- The honest headline is the range across defensible bases: on the normalized median base the weighted IRR is 11.65% (IV@15% $6.19); on the latest-FY base ($0.82/ADS, run with the same scenarios via --base-oe-ps) the weighted IRR is 14.69% and IV@15% is $8.40, essentially the current price. Both are Tier C — even the generous base does not clear the 15% hurdle at $8.63. A future FY2025-facts run could shift this again: FY2025 reported profit jumped, but a material part was non-recurring other gains, and Ximalaya consolidation adds amortization and opex (Q2 2026 opex +12% YoY).
- Quality is not the debate: OE positive 5/5 years, SBC is a modest $81.65M against $1.41B of FY2024 OCF, capex is ~3% of OCF, the balance sheet holds ~$6.5B of cash-like assets, and capital return (dividend + buybacks) is substantial. The debate is purely price: at $8.63 the market already pays for the recovery the median base hasn't caught up with.
- Risks: ByteDance's Soda Music competing for listening time; music-catalog cost inflation at renewal; social entertainment's decline not yet finished; Ximalaya integration cost and amortization; China ADR/VIE and regulatory overhang that no DCF input captures.

## Final verdict
- **Final tier: C** (weighted IRR 11.65% on the normalized base; method range C throughout — 11.65% median base to 14.69% latest-FY base)
- Confidence: **Low** (engine filing data ends FY2024 — the FY2025 20-F is filed but absent from EDGAR companyfacts — and the scenario spread is 4.84x)
- One-liner: High-quality net-cash China music leader, moat 6/10 — but $8.63/ADS does not clear 15%: weighted IRR 11.7% on the normalized base (weighted IV@15% $6.19); even the latest-FY base reaches only 14.7%. Clears 15% at ~$6.19/ADS or below.
